programs.title: Finally Caught
programs.desc: The case of Gretchen Anthony, a woman known for her vibrant and positive personality, unfolds as a chilling tale of domestic violence and deceit; in March 2020, her estranged husband, David Anthony, murdered her in their Florida home.

programs.title: Retrograde
programs.desc: A minor traffic citation spirals into an all-consuming obsession for a young woman when she decides to take on the police and the city.

programs.title: Psycho Therapy: The Shallow Tale of a Writer Who Decided to Write About a Serial Killer
programs.desc: A writer befriends a retired serial killer in a desperate attempt to find inspiration for his next novel and save his marriage. Covering as his marriage counselor, the killer teaches him his methods as reality becomes deadlier than fiction.

programs.title: Confessions of a Cam Girl
programs.desc: An 18-year-old creates an explicit content page online to raise $10,000 to go to fashion school. Confident that she can keep her side hustle under wraps, her secret unravels and threatens not just her future, but the safety of her family as well.

programs.title: A Killer Behind Closed Doors
programs.desc: Melissa learns that her new husband, Kevin, is a philanderer with no ambition. The two become roommates from hell while Kevin remains in the house until the divorce is finalized, but when he turns up dead, all eyes are on Melissa.

programs.title: Campton Manor
programs.desc: A horror writer spends the night alone in a mansion to solve a decades-old mystery.
